description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayAgentChannel component of the OpenClaw project, testing its delivery logic and initializer behavior.

classes.name: GatewayAgentChannelTests
classes.description: A struct containing test cases for GatewayAgentChannel functionalities, verifying delivery predicates and raw value initialization fallback.

methods.name: `should deliver blocks web chat`
methods.description: Test whether the webchat channel correctly indicates it should not deliver blocks in the given conditions.

methods.name: `should deliver allows last and provider channels`
methods.description: Test the shouldDeliver method across last, whatsapp, telegram, googlechat, bluebubbles channels, checking positive and negative cases.

methods.name: `init raw normalizes and falls back to last`
methods.description: Test the raw initializer of GatewayAgentChannel, verifying normalization and fallback to last channel for invalid inputs.
